paper_title: A Simple Greedy Algorithm for Dynamic Graph Orientation
statement: For all known strategies that maintain out-degree δ with σ (amortized) flips, it holds that δσ = Ω(α log n) and most achieve δσ = Θ(α log n). Can one design a strategy with δσ = o(α log n)?
context: 6.3 Open problems For all known strategies that maintain out-degree δ with σ (amortized) flips, it holds that δσ = Ω(α log n) and most achieve δσ = Θ(α log n). Can one design a strategy with δσ = o(α log n)?
